facts.fact: Egypt's Ministry of Communications and Information Technology runs a four-pillar digital capability programme for employees of the State's administrative apparatus, delivered through distance learning by ITIDA, NTI and the National Anti-Corruption Academy.
The Fundamentals of Digital Skills Program, implemented by ICDL Arabia, targets all employees of the state's administrative apparatus.

EGY.note: The document covers training for state administrative employees only, not the public.
